scientific_integrity: A finite-state classification proved by conserved gap residues, directed-cycle reachability, and product-form stationarity, with independent exact-fraction generator checks.
scientific_limitations: Marked-particle finite periodic system only; thermodynamic sector limits, rates of approach, and identification of classes after forgetting the mark are not proved. General multiple-chipping literature might implicitly contain equivalent invariants.
title: Complete dynamical sectors and sector-resolved currents in long-jump exclusion
